options.texture_prompt: Faithfully reproduce the supplied Highland two-handed sword: weathered cool silver-blue steel blade, narrow central fuller with pale ice-blue rune engravings and Celtic interlace near the base. Smooth upward-curving dark steel crossguard with compact leaf-shaped terminals and fine antique bronze borders, a muted deep cyan diamond gem in the central guard. Long dark brown leather-wrapped two-hand grip, steel collars, engraved round wheel pommel with bronze trim and a tiny blue inset. Preserve original fine surface detail, subtle scratches and material boundaries. No extra parts, rust, bright paint, strong baked lighting, circular guard terminals or spikes.
